description: Where this selection connected from: dots are locations sized by activity; lines join one location to the next, colored by the travel speed implied. Read the title line first: many events cannot be placed. Not an impossible-travel detector.

text.expr: length(data('coverage')) && data('coverage')[0].total > 0 ? ['On the map: ' + data('coverage')[0].on_map + '% of events · address cannot be placed: ' + data('coverage')[0].cannot + '%', 'no client IP: ' + data('coverage')[0].no_client_ip + '%' + (data('coverage')[0].before_enrichment !== '0' ? ' · before geo enrichment: ' + data('coverage')[0].before_enrichment + '%' : '')] : 'No activity for this selection in this time range'

subtitle.expr: !length(data('places')) ? '' : extent(pluck(data('places'), 'places'))[1] > 1 ? 'Lines join consecutive locations for one identity; color is the travel speed that would imply.' : 'Each identity was seen from one place in this range, so there is no travel to draw.'

url.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND ((?project == "" OR ?project == "Any") OR project.name == ?project) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR api_key.name == ?identity OR user.name == ?identity OR user.name == REPLACE(REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", ""), "^Unnamed key of ", "") OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any") OR (?identity_kind == "Person" AND user.email IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Unnamed API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Cloud API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Service account" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_service_account") OR (?identity_kind == "Failed sign-in" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) OR (?identity_kind == "Unattributed" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Other" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" AND ENDS_WITH(?identity, " · Cloud API key") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key" AND STARTS_WITH(?identity, "Unnamed key of ") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, "^Unnamed key of ", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name == ?identity) OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any") OR client.ip == TO_IP(CASE((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any"), null, ?client_ip))) | WHERE client.geo.location IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), at = ST_CENTROID_AGG(client.geo.location), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY actor = user.email, city = client.geo.city_name, country = client.geo.country_name | INLINE STATS places = COUNT(*) BY actor | EVAL lon = ST_X(at), lat = ST_Y(at), first_ms = TO_LONG(first_seen), last_ms = TO_LONG(last_seen) | KEEP actor, city, country, places, lon, lat, events, first_seen, last_seen, first_ms, last_ms | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 150

NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Other" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" AND ENDS_WITH(?identity, " · Cloud API key") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key" AND STARTS_WITH(?identity, "Unnamed key of ") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, "^Unnamed key of ", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name == ?identity) OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any") OR client.ip == TO_IP(CASE((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any"), null, ?client_ip))) | STATS n = COUNT(*), located = COUNT(client.geo.location), placed = COUNT(client.geo.country_iso_code) BY client.ip | STATS total = SUM(n), located = SUM(located), with_ip = SUM(CASE(client.ip IS NOT NULL, n, 0)), unplaceable = SUM(CASE(client.ip IS NOT NULL AND placed == 0, n, 0)) | EVAL no_ip = total - with_ip, older = with_ip - unplaceable - located | EVAL r_map = TO_LONG(ROUND(100.0 * located / total)), r_noip = TO_LONG(ROUND(100.0 * no_ip / total)), r_older = TO_LONG(ROUND(100.0 * older / total)) | EVAL r_cannot = 100 - r_map - r_noip - r_older | EVAL on_map = CASE(located == 0, "0", r_map < 1, "<1", TO_STRING(r_map)), no_client_ip = CASE(no_ip == 0, "0", r_noip < 1, "<1", TO_STRING(r_noip)), before_enrichment = CASE(older == 0, "0", r_older < 1, "<1", TO_STRING(r_older)), cannot = CASE(unplaceable == 0, "0", r_cannot < 1, "<1", TO_STRING(r_cannot)) | KEEP total, on_map, cannot, no_client_ip, before_enrichment

transform.calculate: 6371 * acos(min(1, sin(datum.p_lat * PI / 180) * sin(datum.lat * PI / 180) + cos(datum.p_lat * PI / 180) * cos(datum.lat * PI / 180) * cos((datum.lon - datum.p_lon) * PI / 180)))

datum.hours <= 0 ? 'seen in both at overlapping times' : datum.km / datum.hours > 900 ? 'faster than flying (>900 km/h)' : datum.km / datum.hours > 300 ? 'faster than driving (>300 km/h)' : 'plausible travel'

domain: seen in both at overlapping times
